title: We Wish You a Merry Christmas · Kiểu 3
heard: "hãy dựng kiểu mới theo cách phối này" (build a new style the way this project is arranged)
about: v1b: the arrangement of the user's own FL Studio project (Angels We Have Heard on High), as the user asked ("hãy dựng kiểu mới theo cách phối này"), on our instruments: the tune half as fast as sung and an octave up, the left hand unfolding a tone a beat, the warm pad from the first bar, the cellos' slow line, plucked basses from about an eighth of the piece, voices, the violins' line and the violas' chords from a little past a third, bells now and then; 60 a minute, three verses; on the Yamaha upright the user chose for the gentle styles (Kiểu 1 3a's tone: the treble's knock mended).
